name: Gossip
ability: Each day, you may make a public statement. Tonight, if it was true, a player dies.
wakes: Never; the Storyteller acts on the Gossip's behalf each night except the first.
interaction: By day the Gossip publicly makes a definite statement. If true, that night the Storyteller chooses a player (not protected from dying) who dies.
drunk_or_poisoned: If drunk or poisoned at night, no death. Sobriety at the time of the statement does not matter; what matters is health at night.

rulings.text: A false statement causes no death.
Mumbled, whispered or unverifiable statements do not count; it must be public and clearly the Gossip's ability.
A true statement made while drunk or poisoned still kills if the Gossip is sober and healthy that night.
If the Gossip dies before night, no death occurs.
Storyteller should prefer a target who will actually die (not protected e.g. by Fool or Tea Lady).

test_scenarios.name: true statement kills
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Gossip, Bob Imp, Carol Chef, Dan Empath.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 2: Alice says 'Bob is the Imp'. Night 2: Storyteller picks Dan.
test_scenarios.expected: Dan dies; announced at dawn without cause.

test_scenarios.name: false statement
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Gossip, Bob Imp, Carol Chef.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 2: Alice says 'Carol is the Imp'. Night 2.

test_scenarios.name: gossip executed
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Gossip, Bob Imp, Carol Chef.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 2: Alice says 'Bob is evil' (true); Alice is executed.

test_scenarios.name: drunk at statement, sober at night
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Gossip, Bob Sailor, Carol Imp, Dan Chambermaid.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 2: Alice drunk via Sailor, says 'Carol is evil' (true). Sailor's drunkenness ends at dusk. Night 2: Storyteller picks Dan.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned at night
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Gossip, Bob Poisoner, Carol Imp.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 2: Alice says 'Carol is evil' (true). Night 2: Bob poisons Alice before the Gossip's turn.

test_scenarios.name: protected target
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Gossip, Bob Imp, Carol Tea Lady, Dan Chef (Carol's good neighbour).
test_scenarios.actions: True statement; Storyteller chooses Dan, protected by Tea Lady.
test_scenarios.expected: Dan does not die; choosing protected players is legal but discouraged.
